title: Tiered license + usage-credit experiment and maintenance cadence for Private/VPC
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Run a set of commercial experiments for Private/VPC and on-prem packaging focused on reducing procurement friction while preserving predictable unit economics. We will test a hybrid model (license fee + usage credits) and explicit maintenance windows/upgrade cadence options to surface low-friction contracts for mid-market and enterprise buyers. This ticket captures the experiment plan, contract artifacts to prepare, engineering gating items, and the set of success metrics for deciding on general availability pricing/terms.
proposed_pricing_models: Model A: Annual license fee (covers support & minor upgrades) + prepaid token credits for inference consumption; rollover credits up to 20%
Model B: Seat + reserved GPU hours (committed capacity) with burst credits; per-token overage billing at tiered rates
Model C: Flat platform license with optional add-on modules (observability, audit logs) priced as % of license; separate usage bucket billing
Model D: Consumption-first pilot: zero license fee, high-commitment discount on credits to lower procurement friction for POCs
support_tiers: Standard: Business hours email + 48h SLA for severity 1; included with license
Enhanced: 24/7 pager, 4h response for Sev1, quarterly architecture reviews
Premium: Dedicated technical account manager, on-call rotation with 1h response, custom runbooks and annual on-site workshop
Compliance Add-on: SOC2 support, customized security questionnaire responses, annual attestation assistance
upgrade_cadence_options: Option 1: Quarterly minor releases (backwards-compatible) applied in scheduled maintenance windows; monthly opt-in canary for early adopters
Option 2: Bi-annual major upgrades (breaking changes) with 90-day deprecation window and migration playbook
Option 3: Rolling continuous updates for Dedicated customers with feature flags and canary routing; customers choose maintenance blackout windows
Option 4: Customer-managed upgrade (on-prem) with a supported upgrade path and paid upgrade assistance
experiments_plan: Pilot cohort: 6 customers (mid-market + regulated) run Model A vs Model B for 8 weeks to measure procurement lead time and conversion
Pricing elasticity: run 2 price points for prepaid credits (10% and 20% discount) and measure credit consumption velocity and churn over 3 months
Support add-on uptake: offer Compliance Add-on at 1% of license vs fixed $20k to observe preference among regulated customers
Maintenance cadence test: offer Quarterly vs Bi-annual cadence opt-ins with clear rollback windows; measure support tickets and upgrade-related incidents
acceptance_criteria: At least 2 pilot customers convert to annual contracts under one of the proposed models within 90 days
Average procurement lead time reduced by >= 20% for pilot cohort compared to baseline (pre-pilot deals)
Engineering changes required to support model flags and billing are scoped and scheduled in ENG backlog with owners
Runbook and security questionnaire templates delivered and signed off by Legal and Security
Observed customer satisfaction (CSAT) for upgrade windows >= 4/5 in pilot feedback
